name: Sakhalin-2 LNG plant, Prigorodnoye, Russia (Sakhalin Energy)
description: two 4.8 Mtpa dual-mixed-refrigerant trains (9.6 Mtpa design; production 10.3 Mt in 2025), air-cooled design, first LNG February 2009; a third train is still planned
